title: Auto-core configuration (workspace/policies/auto_core.json)
description: Redesign T1. Only a person changes this file. compare never writes state; apply writes through apply_auto_core only when invariants I1-I5 pass and kill_switch is false. kill_switch true stops the run before any read. Redesign T2 (decide, optional keys): decision_mode compare (tickets shown as 'comparing, not for entry', no journal entry) or apply (tickets for entry, journal entries); decision_compare_days_required; decide_schedule_kst. The four optional limit keys can only lower or hold what the decide run issues; when a key is absent the current behaviour applies (no size or count gate, re-issue cap by the formula, research-only strong evidence keeps the design G3 ceiling).
